name: Postwise

pricing.details: Monthly subscription, no long-term contract, cancel anytime; 7-day free trial then auto-subscribe to the plan you picked. Basic 33 €/month — 3 social accounts, 500 AI-generated posts/month, 3 months scheduling, 3 custom AI voices, GhostWriter AI, email support. Boss 53 €/month — 5 social accounts, 1,000 AI posts/month, 12 months scheduling, advanced analytics, email and chat support. Unlimited 88 €/month — unlimited social accounts, unlimited AI posts, unlimited scheduling, custom AI training, priority support. The official FAQ states plans are monthly with no long-term commitments.
